chapter: Chords, recordings and his own groups
title: Reactions to Food for Thought sayings
summary: He comments on his sayings: no family to send him to school, jealousy among guitarists, and critics who find fault.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: 'Food for Thought' -- did you write this?
... 'The biggest fool -- the boy who will not go to school' -- but I thought you didn't go to school much.
... I couldn't. I didn't have no family, you know.
'The best town -- where you succeed' ... 'the most agreeable companion' ... have you run into many of these among musicians?
No, man. A lotta jealousy ... A lotta fellas by me havin' the '4 string' and can play practically the same thing they can with 4 -- they don't particularly like that.
... I busted my fingers up in July...
'The cheapest, stupidest and easiest thing is finding fault' -- you must have a pretty low opinion of critics, then -- or just some critics?
Some critics. Some of 'em do you in just so. I don't know why, just to have somethin' to say. ...
"The greatest need is common sense and long green"
